title: CISA Offers On-Site Incident Response

transcript.speaker: CISA Emergency Response
transcript.text: This is CISA Incident Response Team lead, Agent K. We’ve been assigned to your case as part of the national cyber response protocol. We’ve reviewed your initial logs and confirmed the presence of a long-term APT — Meridian Collective — active for 90 days. We can deploy a full forensic team to your site within 24 hours.

transcript.speaker: CISA Emergency Response
transcript.text: Our team will bring full network forensics tools, malware analysis labs, and real-time threat intelligence. We’ll take lead on the investigation, coordinate with the FBI for prosecution, and manage all federal reporting. We’ll need full access to your network, servers, and logs — including your Domain Controller and PACS systems.

transcript.speaker: CISA Emergency Response
transcript.text: We’ll keep you informed at all levels, but we’ll be in control of the technical investigation. Do you accept our assistance? We need a decision by 10:30 today.

voiceStyles.CISA Emergency Response: Male, mid-40s, calm, authoritative, with a clipped tone and a slight background hum of a secure comms line

instructorNote: This inject tests the airport’s willingness to cede investigative control to federal agencies. Watch for hesitation around federal involvement, or overconfidence in internal recovery. The FBI and CISA will not accept partial access — they need full network visibility.
